name: DAU — qualified active libraries, rolling 24 hours
description: Distinct central-library IDs with a qualifying human action during the last 24 hours, up to now. This is the headline daily active metric; opens and updates do not qualify. Opted-out activity is excluded.

source.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event = 'app_active' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND timestamp < now()

name: WAU — active libraries, rolling 7 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event = 'app_active' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND timestamp < now()

name: MAU — active libraries, rolling 30 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event = 'app_active' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now()

name: Qualified libraries by UTC date — 30 day trend
description: Distinct libraries with generic qualifying activity signals; at most one signal per six hours. Rolling 24-hour/7-day/30-day windows are approximate, exclude offline/failed sends, and never sum daily uniques.

source.query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event = 'app_active' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now() GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

name: App-open signals — rolling 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days
description: At most one app-open signal per library per six hours, triggered by opening the interface. Counts are sampled signals, not total launches. Opens do not qualify for DAU/WAU/MAU; offline and failed sends are excluded.

source.query:
SELECT period, app_opens, opening_libraries FROM (
SELECT 1 AS period_order, '24 hours' AS period, count(DISTINCT uuid) AS app_opens, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS opening_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND event = 'app_opened' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND timestamp < now()
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS period_order, '7 days' AS period, count(DISTINCT uuid) AS app_opens, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS opening_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND event = 'app_opened' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND timestamp < now()
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS period_order, '30 days' AS period, count(DISTINCT uuid) AS app_opens, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS opening_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND event = 'app_opened' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now()
) ORDER BY period_order

name: Active libraries by country — 30 days
description: Distinct libraries with generic qualifying activity signals; at most one signal per six hours. Rolling 24-hour/7-day/30-day windows are approximate, exclude offline/failed sends, and never sum daily uniques.

source.query: SELECT properties.$geoip_country_code AS country, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND properties.qualifying_activity = true AND event = 'app_active' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY country ORDER BY active_libraries DESC

name: Website visitors and conversions — 30 days
description: Explicit event contract. Distinct central-library IDs are a user proxy; opt-outs are excluded. Website IDs remain separate. Data appears after release.

source.query: SELECT event, count() AS events, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS browsers FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'website' AND event IN ('$pageview','download_clicked','download_redirected','github_clicked') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC

name: In-app update stages — 30 days
description: Clicks, verified fresh downloads, and replacement-app launches by target version. Cache reuse is excluded from completed downloads. Stages overlap and are never added to GitHub totals or qualified actives. Empty until the analytics release ships.

source.query: SELECT event AS update_stage, properties.target_version AS target_version, count(DISTINCT uuid) AS events, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS libraries FROM events WHERE properties.source = 'app' AND event IN ('update_check_clicked','update_download_clicked','update_download_completed','update_download_failed','update_install_clicked','update_install_completed','update_install_failed') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now() GROUP BY update_stage, target_version ORDER BY target_version, update_stage
